note: dep spikes/H74_atom_attribution carries carry.sh v3, committed with this row; any residue is other lanes' and not mine to commit.

controls.name: attribution_makes_false_accusations
controls.must_fire_because: the row turns on whether WORK_QUEUE rows can be attributed WITHOUT false positives; carry.sh output is a public CORRECTION line naming a lane, so a wrong attribution is an accusation against a named peer
controls.can_fail_because: if all 48 scored rows matched ground truth, the attributor is sound, carry.sh SHOULD be widened, and the defect would be the TOOL rather than the habit
controls.null_must_contain: a queue whose rows each name exactly their author, where the attributor would be 100% correct and the scope limit would be an unnecessary restriction
controls.detail: 4 of 48 best-case rows name the wrong lane (8%)

controls.name: best_case_covers_a_minority
controls.must_fire_because: a check whose best case reaches a minority of its subject cannot report completeness, whatever its accuracy on what it does reach
controls.can_fail_because: if rows naming exactly one callsign were the majority and few named none, coverage would not be the problem
controls.null_must_contain: a queue where most rows name exactly one lane, so coverage would be high and only accuracy would be at issue
controls.detail: 48 of 187 rows scoreable (26%); 76 name no lane at all

controls.name: channel_is_positionally_decidable
controls.must_fire_because: carry.sh's header claims CHANNEL is the one file where authorship is decidable with no false positives; that claim is load-bearing for the whole verdict and is checked rather than repeated
controls.can_fail_because: a high ambiguous count would mean CHANNEL cannot adjudicate and the whole measurement is unsound
controls.null_must_contain: a CHANNEL where ids routinely resolve to several callsigns, which would undermine the ground truth this row is scored against
controls.detail: 7 of 156 ids resolve to more than one lane

falsifier: if every scored row matched ground truth, the attributor is sound, carry.sh should be WIDENED, and the defect is the tool
